{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Deadline 1 March 2026 governs all rule evaluations.
Length requires 22 pages exactly 22 satisfies rule.
Format demands official template or revision history documented for 3 years.
Tier-1 venue presentations handled only if occurred more than 18 months before deadline.
Exactly 18 months fails R3 exclusion condition.
Prior round acceptances rejected if fewer than 5 years elapsed since round.
5 years exactly qualifies for handling under R4.
Withdrawals do not count as acceptances but reset R3 clock to withdrawal date.
Paired submissions permit exactly 2 manuscripts 3 or more invalid form.
Both paired manuscripts must independently satisfy R1 and R2 conditions.
At least one paired manuscript must satisfy R3 venue overlap restriction.
Track D exempt from R2 requires exactly 2 endorsements one insufficient.
R6 exemption applies to R2 only not other rules in document.
Open retraction notice prevents handling regardless of every other rule including R9.
Standard figure count between 8 and 45 inclusive mandatory for submission.
Paired submission figures range 8 to 70 inclusive minimum same as standard.
Fewer than minimum figures triggers PADDED verdict padding up rather than returned.
More than applicable maximum figures returns outright without exception.
Submission failing R9 plus any other rule returns instead of pads.
Verdicts resolve HANDLED RETURNED or PADDED exclusively based on rule satisfaction.
Withdrawals reset venue clock regardless of acceptance status under prior rounds.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"llama3.3:70b","options":{"seed":1208260484,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false}
